executable_actions.on_failure: If team_aggregate or a peer identifies a cross-layer contradiction, return the specific edge/order/FIFO/join contract to pipeline_planning and block Stage-4 binding on that edge until corrected.
executable_actions.rationale: Hand off the ready data-transfer review to team_aggregate so peer specialists consume checker-grounded Stage-3 observations. The reviewed plan has exact data/stream edge mirroring, correct transfer counts and full AXI beat alignment, atomic ready/valid split behavior, all-input join behavior, and bounded acyclic FIFO liveness with no current Stage-3 contradiction.

observations: data_edges and stream_edges are identical 11-edge sets and include block_input input, both residual-skip branches, and block_output boundary edges; stream mirroring is complete.

All reviewed edges use ready_valid, full_beats_only, and stream_beats_per_axi_beat=8; with 512-bit/64-byte AXI beats, transfer byte counts are exact: seq_len 16 x width 768 -> 12288 bytes -> 192 AXI beats, and seq_len 16 x width 3072 -> 49152 bytes -> 768 AXI beats.
transfer_order [token, tile, lane, word] is uniform across all data/stream edges and is consistent with token-major tensor shapes and the declared lane/word beat path.

Both branch split contracts use ready_valid_broadcast_with_per_output_fifo; source beat acceptance requires all branch FIFOs to enqueue the same token/tile/lane/word, preserving branch order and coupling backpressure without permitting partial duplication.

Both join contracts use all_required_inputs_valid_before_fire with pairing key [token, tile, lane, word]; each join input edge is backed by a bounded FIFO, so the join cannot fire on a mismatched branch beat.

buffer_plan contains 11 concrete bounded ready/valid FIFOs; residual and branch-adjacent edges are depth 64, while simple adjacent-stage decoupling edges are depth 32; the stage graph is acyclic, so backpressure can stall but not create a structural cycle.

The supplied liveness_backpressure_check correctly records that bounded FIFOs provide elasticity and backpressure, not latency-equality or worst-case-skew proof; Stage-3 symbolic latencies are planning metadata only.
sacg_memory_truth shows zero active contamination barriers, backtrack requests, or retry requests, so there is no current SACG-memory blocker.

The exact sub-agent acceptance checker names data_order_trace_check, transfer_count_check, and deadlock_watchdog are not separately named in the supplied checker_results, but equivalent current Stage-3 evidence is present through stream_data_edge_mirror_check, edge_stream_contract_check, branch_join_contract_check, buffer_contract_check, and liveness_backpressure_check.
proposed_actions: At Stage 4 parameter binding, preserve transfer_order=[token,tile,lane,word], full_beats_only, stream_beats_per_axi_beat=8, branch atomic duplication, and all-input join contracts.

At Stage 5 memory/runtime codegen, derive activation region sizes and transfer counts from configured sequence length <= target_max_seq_len and preserve 64-byte AXI alignment; defer concrete DDR/XDMA base addresses to exact board-wrapper discovery.

At verification_artifacts planning, schedule data_order_trace_check, transfer_count_check, and deadlock_watchdog on real VCS compile-only evidence in bottom-up order; do not require runtime or golden comparison for verification acceptance.

If future real backpressure evidence shows residual-skip FIFO occupancy/order failure, localize to the earliest split or join edge and request bounded pipeline_repair with approval before changing buffer depths.
output.summary: Data-transfer review is ready. data_edges and stream_edges mirror exactly, transfer counts and AXI full-beat alignment are consistent, ready/valid split and join contracts are atomic/all-input guarded with bounded FIFOs, and the directed graph is acyclic. No current Stage-3 data-order, transfer-count, branch/join, or liveness blocker is visible.
